description.value: Brentwood Bay Resort & Spa is a 33-room adults-only luxury boutique resort perched on the edge of a glacial fjord on the Saanich Inlet, a short ride from downtown Victoria. The property is built around water-based experiences — a full marina with boat tours and a shuttle to The Butchart Gardens — alongside a spa with heated outdoor pools, thermal sauna, and cold plunge. Multiple on-site dining venues serving local Vancouver Island ingredients make it a self-contained recovery destination for touring cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.
